projects.title: Measuring Entrepreneurial and Industry Identity in the Asteroid-Mining Industry with NLP
projects.summary: Build an NLP pipeline that collects longitudinal text data (company websites, communications, interviews, media) and uses machine learning to separate general topics from individual and collective identity claims in the asteroid-mining industry. The project studies how entrepreneurs and institutions describe themselves as a new industry takes shape.

projects.title: Tracking Novel Research Through the Publication Process: A Text-Embedding Approach
projects.summary: Measure the novelty of submitted manuscripts with text embedding models for semantic similarity, and build a framework matching rejected papers to their eventual publications. The goal is to study scientific conservatism in peer review, using anonymized manuscript metadata and peer review outcomes from over 2,000 Elsevier journals provided through the ICSR Lab collaboration.

projects.title: Construire avec le risque : crues éclair et projet urbain à Kinshasa (projet DIGIKIN)
projects.summary: Student project on designing urban projects in Kinshasa that take flash-flood risk into account, within the DIGIKIN project.

projects.title: Habiter les quartiers informels : densité, santé et services de base
projects.summary: Student project on informal neighbourhoods, focusing on density, health and access to basic services.

projects.title: Patrimoine moderne africain : documenter et projeter (en lien avec WikiArchi)
projects.summary: Student project on documenting modern African architectural heritage and proposing future uses for it, in connection with WikiArchi.

projects.title: Tours et immeubles : comprendre la verticalisation de Dakar, Kigali ou Luanda (projet VERTICAF)
projects.summary: Student project studying the vertical growth of African cities, using Dakar, Kigali or Luanda as case studies, within the VERTICAF project.

projects.title: Cover crops as an adaptation strategy: designing future climate and management scenarios
projects.summary: Identifies combinations of irrigation and management under future climate scenarios that keep cover crops beneficial for both crop yield and soil organic carbon, by running the T&C-crop model at existing sites.

projects.title: Project 1: Nonlinear and nonlocal sediment transport in steep mountainous landscapes (master thesis)
projects.summary: Explores nonlinear and nonlocal sediment transport in steep terrain through 1D and 2D simulations with far-from-equilibrium transport laws, and their effects on erosion rates, hillslope morphology and long-term landscape evolution.

projects.title: Project 1: Soil formation and sediment transport (semester project)
projects.summary: Examines how soil formation and depth-dependent sediment transport interact to control soil thickness and hillslope morphology over geologic timescales.

projects.title: Project 2: Rainfall, surface water and landscape evolution (semester project)
projects.summary: Learn landscape evolution modelling and run simulations with an efficient surface-water solver, comparing predicted river widths with river widths measured from digital elevation models using GIS, then tuning model parameters to reproduce observed landscape properties.

projects.title: Project 2: Rainfall variability and river network evolution (master thesis)
projects.summary: Investigates how the intensity and duration of short-term rainfall variability, with intense storms separated by dry periods, influence river network formation and long-term topographic evolution.

projects.title: Reconstructing long-term river organic carbon dynamics using machine learning
projects.summary: Uses an existing dataset of 53 catchments to reconstruct river total organic carbon time series from sparse observations with machine learning (LSTM, random forest and seasonal regression), and to assess long-term trends.

projects.title: Soil erosion and deposition effects on carbon and vegetation across climates and ecosystems: a multi-site modeling study (PDM and semester project)
projects.summary: Applies the 1D T&C-BG-Erosion ecohydrological model at multiple sites along a climatic gradient to assess how erosion and deposition affect soil organic carbon, nutrients and vegetation productivity across climates and ecosystems.

projects.title: Thirsty computing: Scenario planning for data centre water risk (Project at IMD Business School)
projects.summary: Builds a scenario-based framework to assess water-related risk for data centre portfolios under climate and demand uncertainty, comparing planning strategies under hydroclimatic and water-supply scenarios.

projects.title: Assessment of Reinforced Concrete Structures by fib Model-Code 2020
projects.summary: Assess structural elements designed according to the CEB-FIP Model Code 1978 (fib bulletin 144), such as a post-tensioned box-girder road bridge, using the fib Model Code 2020 design tools and its different levels of approximation. The project compares past and current code verifications and designs cost-effective retrofits where needed to comply with current prescriptions.

projects.title: Effects of extreme heatwaves on the Antarctic snow and firn
projects.summary: Systematically study how extreme atmospheric heatwaves in Antarctica affect snow and firn, including melt, refreezing, densification and surface energy balance. The work combines reanalysis-based detection of heatwaves with long-term distributed SNOWPACK simulations across Antarctica.

projects.title: First simulations with the new community snow model (“Helmut”)
projects.summary: Execute first simulations with Helmut, the new French/Swiss land surface model being developed by CEN (Météo-France) and SLF Davos, and compare its results with the state-of-the-art SNOWPACK model. The work takes place at SLF Davos.

projects.title: Modeling blowing snow events in the Arctic
projects.summary: Use the CRYOWRF model, with blowing-snow equations coupled to SNOWPACK, to study how blowing snow particles are transported and influence cloud microphysics and sea salt aerosol in the Arctic. Simulations will be validated against MOSAiC expedition observations.

projects.title: Monin-Obukhov theory and surface exchange
projects.summary: Investigate whether radiation penetration into the snow can explain the underestimation of latent heat fluxes in current models, combining numerical modelling with snow temperature measurements. Modelling will use SNOWPACK and OpenFOAM to capture vapour transport across the snow-atmosphere interface.

projects.title: Studying the atmospheric circulation and their related snow effects using observational methods at SLF Davos
projects.summary: Deploy a LIDAR system in the Flüela valley during winter and use data from the new Tschuggen station to study how mesoscale circulations (katabatic winds, rotors, etc.) affect snow in an Alpine valley. The work is a master's thesis at SLF Davos.

projects.title: Studying the heat flux representation by different reanalysis and climate models
projects.summary: Compile surface heat flux datasets over Antarctica and analyse them to quantify the uncertainty of reanalyses and climate models. The project also includes CRYOWRF simulations to examine the importance of grid resolution.

projects.title: Towards an Arctic Wind Atlas for Greenland and Svalbard based on machine-learning bias-correction of climate model reanalysis (CARRA)
projects.summary: Develop an Arctic wind atlas for Greenland (and possibly Svalbard and other Arctic regions) by applying machine-learning bias correction to CARRA reanalysis wind fields, using in situ observations and sub-grid orographic predictors. The aim is spatially continuous, bias-corrected wind distributions and wind energy metrics.

projects.title: Habiter l'autoroute
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title names the highway as the site of housing.

projects.title: Habiter la corniche
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title places the housing along the coastal corniche.

projects.title: Habiter les industries hors-la-ville
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title focuses on housing in obsolete industrial infrastructure outside the city.

projects.title: Habiter les infrastructures hydrauliques
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title focuses on housing within water infrastructure.

projects.title: Habiter les plateformes
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title refers to housing on platforms built over urban infrastructure.

projects.title: Habiter les quartiers ouverts
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title targets the open housing estates bordering the city.

projects.title: Les coopératives ouvrières
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns worker cooperative housing.

projects.title: Les garages dans la topographie
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns garages integrated into the topography of the city.

projects.title: Les habitations disposées en série
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns housing arranged in series.

projects.title: Les infrastructures franchissant la vallée du Flon
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns infrastructure crossing the Flon valley.

projects.title: Les plateformes d'immeuble accessibles à 2 niveaux
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns building platforms accessible on two levels.

projects.title: Les raccourcis piétons
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns pedestrian shortcuts across the city.

projects.title: Les rives du lac privatisées
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns the privatised lakeshore.

projects.title: Les rues-belvédère
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns streets conceived as lookout points over the city.

projects.title: Active Sound Source Localization and Ego-Noise Mitigation for Mobile Robots
projects.summary: Develop an onboard acoustic localization framework in which a mobile robot with a microphone array localizes sound sources despite its own motor and wheel noise. The work characterizes and suppresses ego-noise, then implements multi-channel localization (GCC-PHAT, SRP-PHAT or trilateration) and evaluates it on real hardware.

projects.title: Asymmetric Multi-modal Deep Vision Model Compression
projects.summary: Compress neural networks that fuse RGB and thermal images so they can run in real time on small robots with limited compute. The project applies pruning and quantization to reduce memory, inference time and energy, and studies how robust each visual modality is to compression.

projects.title: Comparing PSO and Reinforcement Learning for Training Robot Controllers
projects.summary: Perform a fair comparison of Particle Swarm Optimization and reinforcement learning when both train the same feedforward neural network controller on a multi-robot benchmark. The project includes a literature review, implementation of both algorithms in a high-fidelity simulator, and analysis of the solutions found under comparable evaluation budgets.

projects.title: Cooperative Gas Source Localization with Infrastructure-Free UWB Positioning
projects.summary: Investigate cooperative gas source localization with heterogeneous robot teams whose positions come from infrastructure-free UWB relative localization. The student builds a simplified 2D gas-source environment, implements a cooperative estimation algorithm, and evaluates it with ground-truth, noisy and UWB-estimated robot positions.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Gas Source Localization
projects.summary: Extend the reinforcement learning approach for gas source localization (DDPG, SAC on a Gas Distribution Mapping basis) to a multi-robot system using multi-agent RL. The work studies what information agents should exchange, robustness to communication limits such as packet drops, and efficient message compression.

projects.title: Multi-Robot Inspection with ToF-Based Replanning
projects.summary: Detect, cell by cell, where an observed asset differs from its prior voxel map using onboard Time-of-Flight depth frames, and replan viewpoints and task assignments accordingly in a multi-MAV inspection system. The approach is evaluated in Webots on deliberately modified assets and, if time allows, with real MAVs.

projects.title: Robotic Gas Sensor Calibration
projects.summary: Design an efficient calibration set-up, run before take-off, to estimate absolute gas concentration with low-cost MOX and PID gas sensors mounted on a quadcopter. The set-up integrates temperature, humidity, flow, gas sensors and actuators (pump, valve, quadcopter), building on prior deconvolution work to compensate slow sensor dynamics.

projects.title: Robust indoor–outdoor state estimation for a compact multirotor
projects.summary: Design and test a sensor fusion strategy that keeps the position estimate of a micro aerial vehicle continuous and accurate when flying between outdoor (GNSS) and indoor (visual-inertial odometry) spaces. The work measures sensor behaviour across transitions in real flights and reproduces the degradations in Webots simulation.

projects.title: Thermal Burst Imaging for Optical Gas Imaging
projects.summary: Increase the signal of thermal frames for detecting weak signals such as gas by burst imaging with motion-compensated dense image matching. The method must be robust to a dynamic scene and can use classic variational methods, learned methods, or a combination.

projects.title: Three-Dimensional UWB Localization for Heterogeneous Ground–Aerial Robot Teams
projects.summary: Extend a Webots UWB localization simulation framework so that aerial robots can be localized with ground-based anchors, including 3D estimation and LOS/NLOS measurement models. The work is evaluated across environments, anchor configurations and aerial trajectories, with optional hardware-in-the-loop and motion-capture experiments for a master project.

projects.title: Vision-Language Uncertainty Maps for Drone Search
projects.summary: Build a per-cell probability and uncertainty map of target location for drone search, combining a satellite-image prior scored with a vision-language model, a fine-tuned compact VLM detector on drone images, and in-flight observations. The method is benchmarked in simulation on satellite images with known target locations.

projects.title: 4forests
projects.summary: The project uses explainable machine learning on satellite imagery to identify drivers of tropical deforestation and patterns of landscape change at global scale. The goal is to predict future deforestation before trees are cut, rather than only detecting it after the fact.

projects.title: AI for topographic mapping
projects.summary: Develop new robust AI models for land cover and land use mapping from satellite and aerial imagery, addressing difficulties in class delimitation, multi-modal data integration (e.g. text and ground-level images), and model interpretability. The work is carried out with Swisstopo.

projects.title: An AI assistant to interact with remote sensing images
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a natural-language interface that lets non-experts extract information from satellite images by asking questions in English and receiving answers. It applies remote sensing visual question answering and aims for transparent, interpretable answers.

projects.title: Knowledge-guided Explanations for Satellite Images
projects.summary: Develop approaches that describe satellite images and their changes in natural language, producing explanations accessible to non-experts. The work uses knowledge from large textual corpora such as Wikipedia or specialised web pages, in collaboration with the NLP lab.

projects.title: Mapping vulnerable populations with AI
projects.summary: The project aims to create fine-grained population maps for developing countries, where census data are outdated and only available as coarse aggregate counts. It uses weakly supervised machine learning on the available coarse census data and open geodata, with the goal of predicting fine-grained population censuses in Africa. The maps are intended to support humanitarian action by NGOs.

projects.title: Transforming Underwriting for Commercial Insurance with High-Resolution Remote Sensing
projects.summary: The project addresses the problem of limited labeled data in very high resolution aerial imagery. It investigates how change detection models can be learned efficiently under these conditions. The project is run with AXA as partner.

projects.title: Aerosol background concentrations at Neumayer Station III
projects.summary: Analyze long-term observational aerosol data from the Neumayer Station III in coastal Antarctica.

projects.title: Analysis of Bioaerosol Measurements from the West Coast of Greenland
projects.summary: Process and analyse WIBS (Wideband Integrated Bioaerosol Sensor) measurements collected in Greenland's west-coast fjords during the summers of 2025 and 2026. The work applies statistical methods to characterise Arctic bioaerosol types and their variability under different environmental conditions.

projects.title: Improvement of a tethered balloon payload
projects.summary: Perform laboratory experiments and code data processing routines to improve a tethered balloon payload.

projects.title: Processing aerosol particles concentration data from airborne measurements in coastal Antarctica
projects.summary: Combine airborne aerosol particle concentration measurements, GPS tracks and ERA5 reanalysis data from the RINGS campaign in coastal Antarctica (summer 2024-25) to characterize particle concentrations and their size distribution. Results are to be compared with the literature and with EERL balloon-borne measurements at Neumayer III station. A master's thesis could extend this to horizontal and vertical variations linked to atmospheric circulation and air-mass source case studies.

projects.title: An efficient point cloud compression via harmonic decomposition
projects.summary: Develop a modelling framework for walls built from demolition pieces, storing point cloud data as expansion coefficients of spherical, hemispherical or disk harmonics instead of explicit surface data.

projects.title: Behaviour of building aggregates in a city center
projects.summary: Study how different building heights within building aggregates in Zagreb, affected by the 2020 Croatia earthquakes, influence their behaviour, damage mechanisms and fragility, using nonlinear numerical models in OpenSees.

projects.title: Building Inelastic Torsional Response and Design Guidelines
projects.summary: Conduct inelastic dynamic analyses of simple structures to quantify torsional response, compare prediction methods with time-history results, and derive simple guidance for design standards on when torsional effects matter and how to consider them.

projects.title: Deep learning for feature matching in geometrical digital twinning of stone masonry walls
projects.summary: Implement and compare traditional (SIFT, ORB) and deep learning (SuperPoint, D2-Net) feature matching methods and integrate them into a 3D reconstruction pipeline for geometrical digital twins, evaluating accuracy, robustness and efficiency.

projects.title: Design of a RC building
projects.summary: Working in groups of two, design the structural system of a regular multi-storey reinforced concrete building that transfers loads from the superstructure to the foundation.

projects.title: Effect of the axial load ratio (ALR) in the horizontal stiffness in stone masonry walls
projects.summary: Evaluate how the axial load ratio affects the stiffness of stone masonry walls by running pushover analyses in OpenSees with an equivalent frame model in which the elastic modulus depends on ALR, and comparing with experimental curves from literature.

projects.title: Erosion properties of earthen materials
projects.summary: Experimentally investigate the erosion of earthen construction materials such as rammed earth and compressed earth blocks under freeze-thaw cycles, wind and rain, and estimate the influence of soil composition.

projects.title: Experimental assessment of shear strength at the concrete-mortar interface
projects.summary: Experimentally test the shear strength of concrete-mortar interfaces with various sustainable mortar types and precompression levels, complemented by life cycle assessment of masonry solutions and numerical wall-level simulations.

projects.title: Generation of geometrical digital twins of stone masonry walls using an image-based pipeline
projects.summary: Use an existing image-based pipeline and available datasets to reconstruct rubble stone masonry wall geometry, extract individual stones and refine digital models for numerical analysis, including automating detection and correction of stone collisions.

projects.title: Improving the in-plane stiffness of compressed earth floors
projects.summary: In collaboration with Terrabloc, test bonding systems (screws, pins, etc.) between wood boards and beams or rammed earth elements to improve the in-plane strength and stiffness of an Earth-Timber floor, then propose and test a practical solution at real scale.

projects.title: Numerical investigation of masonry microstructure influence on the seismic response of multi-leaf rubble stone walls
projects.summary: Develop and calibrate a micro-continuum model of multi-leaf rubble stone walls in Abaqus, then run parametric simulations on virtual and real microstructures to correlate geometric indices with strength, stiffness and drift capacity.

projects.title: Numerical simulation and uncertainty evaluation of shake-table building tests
projects.summary: Build an equivalent frame model of a building tested on a shake table, simulate its seismic response, and compare it with experimental measurements to interpret discrepancies and uncertainties in model calibration and validation.

projects.title: Numerical simulation of modern masonry walls with bed-joint reinforcement under seismic loading
projects.summary: Use a micro-modelling approach to calibrate a numerical model of modern brick masonry walls against EESD tests, then assess how different bed-joint reinforcement typologies and ratios affect their in-plane seismic response.

projects.title: Numerical simulation of the effect of flanges on the seismic response of modern masonry walls
projects.summary: Use a micro-modelling approach calibrated on EESD experimental tests to investigate how different flange geometries and configurations affect the in-plane seismic response of brick masonry walls.

projects.title: Numerical simulation of the in-plane response of rammed earth walls
projects.summary: Review modelling approaches for rammed earth, select and validate constitutive models against experimental data, and use the model to study the in-plane response of rammed earth walls under diverse boundary conditions.

projects.title: Optimization-based rigid block modeling for historic rubble masonry building across scales
projects.summary: Analyse a rubble masonry building by combining micro-scale rigid block models of each element, used for limit analysis, with macro models assembled into a full-building pushover analysis, using a Python interface.

projects.title: Optimization-based rigid block modeling of URM pier spandrel systems with macro elements
projects.summary: Model unreinforced masonry pier spandrel systems with macro elements using an optimization-based rigid block method, identifying failure mechanisms and performing limit and pushover analysis via a Python interface. Other case studies are also available.

projects.title: Seismic assessment of historic rubble masonry building via optimization-based rigid block modeling
projects.summary: Apply an optimization-based rigid block model to building-level seismic analysis of a historic rubble masonry case study, including limit analysis and pushover analysis through its Python interface.

projects.title: Structural system documentation of an existing masonry building
projects.summary: Survey and document the structural system, materials and key details of a Swiss building scheduled for renovation or demolition, and qualitatively discuss its weak points under various loads, with some quantitative assessments.

projects.title: Arsenic methylation as 'microbial warfare' strategy
projects.summary: The project tests the hypothesis that anaerobic microbes methylate arsenic to produce toxic compounds used against competitors, using time-lapse microscopy of a methylator and a control strain co-cultured in microfluidic chips, with image analysis to quantify the warfare effect.

projects.title: Arsenic partitioning in solid and aqueous phases in Mekong Delta sediments
projects.summary: The project investigates arsenic speciation in solid and aqueous phases of Mekong Delta sediments through field observations and laboratory experiments, focusing on how iron mineral transformations and microbial responses to seasonal variation influence arsenic release into groundwater.

projects.title: Development of high-throughput method for DNA extraction from groundwater samples
projects.summary: The project investigates the role of microorganisms in nitrogen transformations in Mekong Delta sediments and their links to arsenic mobility, combining field observations and laboratory experiments, and involves developing a high-throughput method for DNA extraction from groundwater samples.

projects.title: Microdroplet-aided isolation of arsenic-methylating microorganisms from soil
projects.summary: The project aims to optimize a method combining droplet-based microfluidics, arsenic whole-cell biosensors and FACS to isolate anaerobic arsenic-methylating microorganisms from paddy soil, and to further characterize the new isolates.

projects.title: Beyond occupancy through multimodal social sensing
projects.summary: Use multimodal, privacy-preserving sensors (distributed acoustic and environmental measurements) to characterize social interactions in office environments. The project covers sensor deployment, data collection, feature extraction and analysis of how interactions vary across space, time and workspace conditions.

projects.title: Bureau Action Située – Activity space and carbon consumption
projects.summary: Examine how the shape and extent of individuals' activity spaces (covered areas, distances traveled, spatial dispersion) relate to their daily carbon footprint. The aim is to identify low-carbon mobility profiles while maintaining access to essential activities.

projects.title: Bureau Action Située – Mobility of care and transport hubs
projects.summary: Investigate how transport nodes such as train stations, bus stops and multimodal hubs can be redesigned to better accommodate care-related mobility. The project aims to characterize care mobility chains and build multidimensional accessibility indicators to diagnose caregiving-friendly hubs.

projects.title: Bureau Action Située – Multi-scale indicators of walkability and cyclability
projects.summary: Develop a composite index of walkability and cyclability that integrates infrastructure, mobility practices, air pollution and noise across street, neighborhood and municipality scales. The framework will be piloted in the Canton of Vaud, using TLM networks and open data.

projects.title: Clustering of urban form for sustainable mobility
projects.summary: Apply machine learning clustering to urban form data (buildings, street networks, public space) to identify natural city forms. The results are to be interpreted using surveys of residents' experiences as pedestrians and cyclists.

projects.title: Demand flexibility provision in Swiss households
projects.summary: Build a common database of metering and sub-metering data from Swiss households, then develop non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) and customer segmentation models. The project aims to evaluate household demand flexibility potential and design demand flexibility programs, in collaboration with EMPA.

projects.title: Large Language Model (LLM) Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) of Residential Energy Behavior under Flexible Load Management Scenarios
projects.summary: Use existing LLM-agent frameworks to simulate Swiss households' energy behavior, using collected demographic and time-use survey data. The goal is to study population-level behavioural shifts and individual reactions to demand response policies and extreme weather scenarios.

projects.title: Strategies for demand side management based on insights from energy meter disaggregation
projects.summary: Disaggregate household energy meter data with non-intrusive load monitoring to extract appliance usage signatures. The goal is to identify user types and deferrable versus non-deferrable appliances, and to develop household-specific demand response strategies.

projects.title: Understanding the similarities and differences in occupant behavior around the world based on domestic appliances usage
projects.summary: Study global differences and similarities in occupancy and occupant behavior using smart meter data and end-use energy distributions in residential units. The aim is to explain how dwelling type, household size, income, appliances and weather shape energy use.

projects.title: Urban rhythms across public spaces
projects.summary: Use privacy-preserving spatiotemporal observations to identify and compare activity patterns across public spaces. The project develops methods to aggregate, visualize and cluster public spaces by recurring temporal signatures, and to compare shared and city-specific rhythms.

projects.title: Analysis of an in-situ injection experiment at the Bedretto Res. Lab.
projects.summary: Analyse data from an in-situ fluid injection experiment at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory for Geosciences and Geoenergies.

projects.title: Boundary Element simulations for elasto-static
projects.summary: Help develop and test a fast boundary element code in 2D and 3D for elastostatic problems, possibly with many cracks, and apply it to problems in solid mechanics.

projects.title: Design of a polyaxial frame for rock mechanics testing
projects.summary: Use finite element simulations of a true triaxial reacting frame, including platen and sample friction, to design a polyaxial frame for rock mechanics testing.

projects.title: Distributed fiber optic strain sensing – Inversion for load reconstruction
projects.summary: Reconstruct the loading responsible for strain measured by a distributed fiber optic sensing system in a solid of known mechanical properties, combining mechanical experiments and inverse-problem modelling.

projects.title: Elastic rebounding due to retreating Glaciers in the Alps
projects.summary: Study the elastic rebound of Alpine bedrock caused by retreating glaciers.

projects.title: Fluid driven fault re-activation associated with H2 / CO2 storage
projects.summary: Study how pore-pressure and stress changes from subsurface fluid injection or withdrawal can reactivate faults, using finite element thermo-hydro-mechanical modelling.

projects.title: Fracture statistics of quasi-brittle rock from CT scan images
projects.summary: Analyse the statistics of fracture traces picked by a deep convolutional network from more than 10,000 microCT scan images of fractured rock, to learn about fracture in quasi-brittle materials, and possibly retrain the network.

projects.title: Fracture thermal energy storage
projects.summary: Explore the efficiency of storing seasonal heat in impermeable strata by engineering fractures and cycling hydrothermal loading and unloading, using lab experiments and modelling.

projects.title: Imaging of failures using active and passive acoustics
projects.summary: Monitor quasi-brittle materials such as concrete and rock with active and passive acoustics to image the evolution of damage and failure, using signal processing and seismological methods.

projects.title: Imaging of fracture and defects using active and passive acoustics
projects.summary: Image fractures and defects in materials using active and passive acoustic methods.

projects.title: Interaction between Shear-banding & re-inforcements in geotechnical engineering
projects.summary: Study the interaction between shear banding and reinforcements in geotechnical engineering.

projects.title: Limit analysis for geotechnical engineering ULS design
projects.summary: Apply limit analysis to ultimate limit state design in geotechnical engineering.

projects.title: Limit analysis for the design of geotechnical engineering
projects.summary: Numerically model soil-structure interaction problems for the ultimate limit state in geotechnical design. Students must have taken the Computational Geomechanics course.

projects.title: Modeling the geomechanical response of hydrogen/co2 storage in porous media
projects.summary: Model the geomechanical response of porous media to hydrogen or CO2 storage.

projects.title: Modelling of the failure of quasi-brittle material
projects.summary: Reproduce numerically novel experiments characterising the fracture mechanical behaviour of quasi-brittle materials such as rock and concrete, in particular the recently developed gap test for concrete failure, using distinct element modelling. The project is carried out in mobility at Georgia Institute of Technology with Prof. H. Huang.

projects.title: Predicting the excavation damage zone of tunnels in quasi-brittle rocks
projects.summary: Predict the extent of the excavation damage zone around tunnels excavated in quasi-brittle rocks.

projects.title: Revisting the Barbarbunga magmatic intrusion sequence
projects.summary: Revisit the magmatic intrusion sequence of the Bárðarbunga volcanic system.

projects.title: Rock slope stability under climate change
projects.summary: Investigate how climate change affects the stability of rock slopes.

projects.title: Understanding hydromechanical deformations around volcanic systems
projects.summary: Study the hydromechanical deformations occurring around volcanic systems.

projects.title: Pollutants analysis in the environment
projects.summary: The project concerns the analysis of pollutants in environmental samples.

projects.title: Fertility decline in low- and middle-income countries
projects.summary: Analyses the decline of fertility rates in low- and middle-income countries.

projects.title: Migration and urbanization in Switzerland
projects.summary: Examines migration and urbanization patterns within Switzerland.

projects.title: Migration in cities of the global south
projects.summary: Studies migration flows and their role in urban growth in cities of the global south.

projects.title: A social-ecological typology of civic nature-based solutions in cities
projects.summary: Aims to develop a social-ecological typology of civic nature-based solutions in cities. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Co-living for urban sufficiency: Identifying regulative and institutional barriers, and well-being impacts of new housing models
projects.summary: Identifies regulative and institutional barriers to co-living and assesses the well-being impacts of new housing models for urban sufficiency. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Exploring Triggers, Co-Adoption Patterns, and Spatial Contexts in the Residential Building Sector
projects.summary: The thesis investigates the spatial heterogeneity of energy retrofits and low-carbon technology adoption in residential buildings, identifying triggers that motivate homeowners to act and how co-adoption dynamics vary across spatial contexts. It builds on the ABM4EnergyTransition survey of 2,410 homeowners in Styria, Austria, using GIS and statistical modelling in R and/or Python.

projects.title: Improving urban land surface temperature mapping: Comparing thermal sharpening methods
projects.summary: Compares thermal sharpening methods to improve the mapping of urban land surface temperature. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Sequencing in urban transitions: Analyzing the role of time in urban transitions
projects.summary: Analyses the role of time and sequencing in urban transitions. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Supply-side interventions and behavioral options in urban provisioning systems: Developing a database and assessment framework for cities
projects.summary: Develops a database and assessment framework for cities covering supply-side interventions and behavioural options in urban provisioning systems. It is offered as a specialization project for the Master in Urban Systems (MUS).

projects.title: Urban metabolism revisited: Quantifying urban stocks of durables and simulating circularity scenarios
projects.summary: Quantifies urban stocks of durable goods and simulates circularity scenarios for cities. It builds on urban metabolism and material flow analysis.

projects.title: Urban resilience at the international level: Using the global human settlement area data for analyzing urban resilience across continents
projects.summary: Uses global human settlement area data to analyse urban resilience across continents. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Assessing building energy performance and indoor thermal conditions under extreme heat
projects.summary: Studies the trade-off between saving building energy and protecting occupants from heat during extreme weather. The project combines engineering and public health methods, and students would work on the energy modelling components.

projects.title: Assessment of air quality and thermal comfort on public transport
projects.summary: Measures air pollutants and thermal comfort parameters inside trains, buses and metros to characterise passenger microenvironments. The goal is to assess exposure and comfort during commuting.

projects.title: Building and testing a low-cost thermal manikin
projects.summary: Hands-on project to design and build a simplified, low-cost thermal manikin as an alternative to commercial models costing over 100,000 CHF. The prototype is tested using infrared imaging, temperature and velocity measurements, and smoke visualization.

projects.title: Building and Testing an Air Cleaner for Enhanced Indoor Air Quality
projects.summary: Students build a Corsi-Rosenthal box air cleaner and test its performance in indoor environments with air quality instrumentation. The project assesses how well the device reduces particulate matter, allergens and other pollutants.

projects.title: Exploring the Global Thermal Comfort Database
projects.summary: Explores the ASHRAE Global Thermal Comfort Database II using its interactive visualization tool and the full dataset. The student identifies variables influencing thermal comfort perception and critically examines standard comfort assumptions.

projects.title: Human inhalation exposure to carbon dioxide and particulate matter in built environment
projects.summary: Aims to better understand individuals' exposure to carbon dioxide and particulate matter across indoor and outdoor spaces in daily life. The project uses portable scientific instruments to measure exposure levels.

projects.title: Indoor air quality and thermal comfort assessment at university campus building
projects.summary: Assesses indoor air quality and thermal comfort in regularly occupied campus offices and an auditorium using multi-pollutant and thermal instruments, combined with occupant surveys. Results are compared with local and international standards and green building certifications.

projects.title: Integrating Indoor Air Quality and Life Cycle Assessment of Ventilation Strategies in Buildings
projects.summary: Compares mechanical, natural and hybrid ventilation strategies in terms of indoor air quality and life-cycle environmental impact, using a real case-study building. The aim is a framework linking IAQ performance with embodied and operational energy.

projects.title: Mapping Spatiotemporal Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ) Dynamics in a Naturally Ventilated Office
projects.summary: Analyses high-resolution IEQ data from about 20 low-cost sensors in a naturally ventilated shared office at EPFL Fribourg. The goal is to quantify spatial and temporal variations and their drivers, such as occupancy, window use and outdoor conditions.

projects.title: Mitigating Dust Exposure in Indoor Climbing Gyms
projects.summary: Measures particle concentrations and size distributions during climbing activities in indoor climbing gyms using optical particle counters. Occupant surveys on comfort and health are combined with the data to identify particle reduction strategies.

projects.title: Performance assessment of natural ventilation in Swiss residences
projects.summary: Investigates the performance of natural ventilation through window openings in residential buildings, considering outdoor conditions and occupant behaviour. The work uses direct measurements in residences or building performance simulation tools such as EnergyPlus.

projects.title: The impact of real-time indoor air quality awareness on occupant behavior and ventilation rates in student dwellings
projects.summary: Investigates whether a visible CO2 meter display changes occupants' behaviour and improves indoor air quality in student dwellings. CO2, temperature and humidity are monitored in bedrooms and living rooms over two weeks, with and without display feedback.

projects.title: Activity-based individual pollution exposure estimation
projects.summary: Aims to estimate personalized air pollution exposure by combining high-resolution pollution data from Lausanne and Geneva with individual mobility traces. The project includes propagating model uncertainty into exposure estimates and validating them.

projects.title: Labeling Algorithm Design for Mobile Sensing Vehicle Routing
projects.summary: Extends classical labeling algorithms from vehicle routing to mobile sensing routing, which involves repeated visits, nonlinear sensing objectives, and diminishing returns. The project includes developing dominance rules and pruning strategies and benchmarking against a commercial solver.

projects.title: Optimal transport based urban pollution modeling and prediction
projects.summary: Investigates whether urban air pollution transport can be modeled with optimal transport, and compares an OT-based spatiotemporal interpolation approach to standard baselines.

projects.title: Pollution-aware route planning for EPFL community (HOMES x Campus Motion)
projects.summary: Develops a routing algorithm for walking and jogging that balances route length, directness, and cumulative air pollution exposure, using HOMES' high-resolution pollution map. The routing is to be tested in daily scenarios with the EPFL community in collaboration with Campus Motion.

projects.title: Scheduling problem of transportation network maintenance
projects.summary: Studies how to schedule maintenance works on road, tram, and rail networks, where links under maintenance are blocked and resources are limited. The goal is to keep network quality while minimizing the impact on transport efficiency.

projects.title: Stationary and mobile info-box location design on EPFL campus (HOMES x Campus Motion)
projects.summary: Formulates a customized facility location problem for placing info boxes on the EPFL campus and proposes adaptive relocation strategies based on user data. The work is evaluated through simulations and/or real data.

projects.title: Accurate Simulation of Materials with Graph Neural Network Finite Element Models
projects.summary: Incorporate material constitutive laws into a graph neural network so that it predicts material stress accurately, and evaluate this physics-informed approach against learning stress as a distinct objective.

projects.title: Battery Lifetime Prediction under Changing Operating Conditions with Neural SDEs
projects.summary: Develop Neural Stochastic Differential Equations that learn battery degradation dynamics from simulated lifetime data generated with NASA's ProgPy, and forecast capacity and remaining useful life under changing future operating schedules.

projects.title: Building Self-Improving AI Research Agents for Prognostics and Health Management
projects.summary: Scale up and extend a multi-step agentic AI workflow that extracts structured knowledge from prognostics and health management papers and links it to benchmark tasks and evaluation criteria, producing a literature-to-evaluation pipeline prototype.

projects.title: Data-Driven Prioritization of Railway Track Inspections
projects.summary: Use historical SBB track measurements, infrastructure information and maintenance records to build predictive models and prioritisation strategies that identify track sections likely to need maintenance within a limited inspection budget.

projects.title: Federated Foundation Models for Electricity Load Forecasting
projects.summary: Build a federated fine-tuning pipeline for time-series foundation models on public smart-meter data, using parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA, and benchmark it against zero-shot, local fine-tuning and centralised training for load forecasting.

projects.title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Networks for Composite Material Simulation
projects.summary: Improve graph neural network surrogates of finite element simulations by adding physical and engineering inductive biases to the architecture, aiming for stable rollouts and simulation of dynamic oscillations of composite plates.

projects.title: Robust Multi-Modal 3D Reconstruction
projects.summary: Develop 3D scene reconstruction methods that combine RGB and thermal imaging without strict pixel-level alignment, using contrastive learning for cross-modal correspondences and feature alignment in 3D space.

projects.title: Structure-Aware Generative Models for Spatiotemporal Systems
projects.summary: Explore how structural information about sensor networks can be built into diffusion and flow matching generative models to improve their effectiveness and efficiency for spatiotemporal signal processing of industrial systems.

projects.title: Test-time Domain Adaptation for OOD Detection
projects.summary: Improve out-of-distribution detection under domain shift by applying and modifying test-time domain adaptation methods so that detection works online during inference, with road anomaly detection as an application case.

projects.title: Dust in the Wind: Analyzing Mineral Dust Acidification and Its Effects
projects.summary: Prepare and analyse samples from an experimental facility that acidifies mineral dust particles, quantifying the physico-chemical changes such as soluble iron and copper, and developing new analytical methods for these components.

projects.title: From Air to Earth: Tracing Atmospheric Reactive Nitrogen's Impact on Swiss Ecosystems
projects.summary: Take part in field measurements of reactive nitrogen deposition at an agricultural site and a forest in Switzerland as part of the ReCLEAN project, including sample collection, data curation and operation of atmospheric instruments.

projects.title: Master Project Proposal: AI-Based Identification of Cloud Hydrometeors from In Situ Holographic and Fluorescence Measurements at Jungfraujoch
projects.summary: Develop a machine learning framework to classify individual cloud particles measured by a multisensor airflow cytometer (holography, fluorescence, polarised light scattering) at the Jungfraujoch station into liquid droplets and primary and secondary ice crystals. The classified data will be used to derive quasi-real-time cloud microphysical properties.

projects.title: Masters or SIE project – Assessment of low cost sensor technologies for spatially-resolved air quality indices in the City of Lausanne
projects.summary: Evaluate low-cost sensors for measuring particulate and gas-phase pollutants in Lausanne, model their environment-dependent response, and derive air quality indices comparable to those from reference stations.

projects.title: Masters project – Molecular Structure Reconstruction
projects.summary: Implement and improve algorithms that reconstruct molecular structures from mass spectrometry fragments, testing them on tandem chromatogram-mass spectrometer measurements of halogenated compounds at Jungfraujoch.

projects.title: Calibration and Utilization of a Novel Biaxial Shear Deformation Apparatus for Rock Discontinuity Analysis
projects.summary: Students calibrate a newly designed biaxial shear apparatus using synthetic rock samples with known properties, then use it to measure shear strength, stress distribution and fracture propagation along rock discontinuities in real samples.

projects.title: Deformation and Failure Properties of Synthetic Sedimentary Rock
projects.summary: Students fabricate synthetic sandstone by hot sintering and synthetic limestone by cold sintering (pressure solution), then characterise their petrophysical and mechanical properties to understand deformation and failure of sedimentary rock.

projects.title: Exploring Effects of Fault Aspect Ratio on Rupture Dynamics through Analog Samples in a Biaxial Shear Apparatus
projects.summary: Students conduct biaxial shear experiments on analog samples of different sizes to determine how fault aspect ratio affects rupture mode and failure response, comparing rate-and-state and slip-weakening friction laws.

projects.title: Exploring the Effects of Normal Stress Oscillations on Rupture Dynamics using Analog Samples in a Biaxial Shear Apparatus
projects.summary: Students run stick-slip experiments on an analog sample in a biaxial shear apparatus, varying the magnitude and amplitude of normal stress oscillations at a fixed load point velocity to study how they affect earthquake-like rupture cycles.

projects.title: High-Pressure High-Temperature Permeability Analysis of Geothermal Reservoir Rocks from Iceland and Canada using Advanced Triaxial Equipment
projects.summary: Students measure the permeability of geothermal reservoir rock samples from Iceland and Canada using the Paterson apparatus at up to 100 MPa and temperatures up to 700°C, to improve understanding of geothermal resource potential.

projects.title: Investigating the physical properties of continental lower crust
projects.summary: Students prepare samples of deep continental crustal rocks from the Ivrea-Verbano region and measure ultrasonic wave velocity, permeability and electrical conductivity under high pressure and temperature (up to 200 MPa and 150°C) in a triaxial machine.

projects.title: Analysis of air pollution sources in global monitoring networks
projects.summary: Contextualize particle chemical composition measurements from global monitoring networks using meteorological analyses and emission inventories, in order to identify atmospheric particle pollution sources. The project is part of the APPLS collaboration with the Swiss Data Science Center and international partners.

projects.title: Analysis of atmospheric aerosol composition and sources with a new automated infrared spectrometer
projects.summary: Study atmospheric aerosols measured with a new online infrared spectrometer conceptualized at EPFL and developed by the spinoff Aerospec SA. Students can choose a data science focus (analysis of aerosols, sources and meteorological conditions from measurement campaigns in Switzerland, Europe, Japan and the Arctic) or an experimental focus (characterization of particle chemical signatures).

projects.title: Back to the Future: The World Energy Outlook forecasts in the rear-view mirror
projects.summary: Statistically analyse historical IEA World Energy Outlook projections (2000 onwards) to identify possible biases, focusing on energy prices, energy balances, electricity generation and CO2 emissions.

projects.title: Cheap clothes, high costs: the hidden costs of fast fashion
projects.summary: Assess and analyse the hidden environmental, social, economic and health costs of the fast fashion value chain using the True Cost Accounting approach, contributing to an SNSF research project.

projects.title: Comment une coopérative d'habitation peut-elle renforcer la durabilité dans son parc de logements ?
projects.summary: Develop a practical guide for housing cooperatives on concrete measures to strengthen social and environmental sustainability in their housing stock, testing some interventions such as encouraging flat-sharing in large apartments, in collaboration with a Lausanne housing cooperative.

projects.title: Designing Swiss fair and sustainable futures: a system modelling assessment of the planetary boundaries and social foundations
projects.summary: Model and quantify current and future environmental impacts of Switzerland through the Doughnut economics framework, combining planetary boundaries and social foundations, and identify gaps with sustainability targets.

projects.title: Developing sustainable deployment strategies for data centres in Switzerland: comprehensive spatial mapping combined with a systems modelling assessment
projects.summary: Build a territorial mapping of suitable locations for sustainable data centre deployment in Switzerland, assessing energy, network, water and waste-heat reuse impacts in urban and peri-urban areas.

projects.title: Estimating the sustainability impacts of the Swiss agrifood system: a system modelling assessment of the Swiss 2030 Agricultural Policy
projects.summary: Model and quantify the GHG mitigation potential and broader sustainability impacts of the key measures of the Swiss 2030 Agricultural Policy (AP30+) using a sector-coupled system modelling approach, in collaboration with the Negawatt association.

projects.title: How to transform existing buildings towards shared spaces?
projects.summary: Identify successful and unsuccessful space-sharing models in existing buildings (shared kitchens, guest rooms, reception and activity spaces) based on literature, then propose new models that reduce m2 per person and support shared activities.

projects.title: Limitations of domestic project-based approaches in Swiss climate policy
projects.summary: Investigate the potential and limitations of domestic project-based climate policy approaches in Switzerland, including additionality frictions between instruments, with stakeholder interviews to draw lessons for the 2030 target and the CO2 Act revision.

projects.title: Making CCUS governance accessible through interactive scenario tools
projects.summary: Design and run a stakeholder workshop using interactive scenario tools to make CCUS governance questions accessible to policymakers and stakeholders, and evaluate which formats best support understanding and deliberation.

projects.title: Proof of Concept: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Assistant for the GEMINI-E3 Model
projects.summary: Develop a proof-of-concept RAG assistant that answers natural-language questions about the GEMINI-E3 computable general equilibrium model, with answers grounded in and cited from its documentation and code.

projects.title: Reframing Living Wages through the lens of Decent Living Standards
projects.summary: Estimate living wages based on Decent Living Standards thresholds rather than minimum consumption baskets, by modelling household needs in energy, food, housing and mobility and identifying gaps with existing living wage benchmarks.

projects.title: Comparaison de codes numériques d'avalanche
projects.summary: Compares numerical codes used to simulate snow avalanches.

projects.title: Effet du niveau de la nappe phréatique sur le charriage
projects.summary: Studies how the level of the groundwater table affects bedload (sediment) transport in rivers.

projects.title: Effet du niveau de la nappe phréatique sur les crues
projects.summary: Investigates how the level of the groundwater table influences floods.

projects.title: Étude des crues des 21 et 29 juin 2024 de la Navisence (Zinal, VS)
projects.summary: Master thesis studying the floods of 21 and 29 June 2024 on the Navisence river at Zinal (Valais, Switzerland).

projects.title: Paramétrisation des modèles de vagues de rupture de barrage avec transport sédimentaire
projects.summary: Master thesis on parameterising dam-break wave models that include sediment transport.

projects.title: Simulation des apports d'un bassin versant pour l'hydroélectricité : prévisions à long et court termes
projects.summary: Master thesis on simulating catchment inflows for hydropower, with long-term and short-term forecasts.

projects.title: How Was the Climate of the French Colonies Taught? A Study of Geography Textbooks from the Late 19th Century to the Mid-20th Century
projects.summary: The project uses text mining on dozens of French geography textbooks from Gallica to study how the climate and meteorology of the French colonies were taught to pupils from the late Second Empire to the Third Republic, and whether a hierarchy among colonial climates appears. The student would harvest the corpus through the Gallica API and apply analyses such as topic modelling.

projects.title: Mapping Open Science Platform
projects.summary: The project aims to crawl the web to identify the links between open science platforms such as repositories, digital libraries and journals, characterise the nature of these links, and produce an interactive map of the open science network.

projects.title: The ecology of eucalyptus: Tracing the acclimatization and exploitation of eucalyptus in Europe through 19th-century French publications
projects.summary: The project uses text mining on about 3,660 nineteenth-century French books from Gallica that mention eucalyptus, to study how knowledge about the tree's acclimatization and uses (medicinal, forestry, agricultural) evolved. The student would harvest the corpus through the Gallica API and apply analyses such as co-occurrence networks and topic modelling.

projects.title: The 'ecosystem' of open science: Tracing the Evolution of Ecological Metaphors in Discourses on the Digital Transition of Research
projects.summary: The project assembles a heterogeneous corpus of scientific, policy and oral texts on the digital transition of research, then uses NLP and network analysis to trace how ecological metaphors such as 'ecosystem' emerged and circulated in these discourses over time.

projects.title: The Global Footprint of the Swiss Economy and Society: A Data-Driven Analysis of Trading Patterns in the 20th Century
projects.summary: The project aims to extract data from digitized Swiss trade statistics from 1890 to 2000 to build a database of imports and exports, and then to analyse the environmental footprint of Switzerland over the twentieth century. The student would first build an extraction pipeline from scanned tables.

projects.title: The use of images in health textbooks: how images and scientific discourse on gender interact between 1870 and 1940
projects.summary: The project examines illustrations in about eighty French-language health manuals published in Switzerland and France between 1870 and 1940, to see how images depict the body and the roles of men and women in medical discourse. It is part of the SNSF-funded MEDIF project on the first women doctors in French-speaking medicine.

projects.title: Decoding the spectral diet of humans: Development of new analysis methods for spectral light exposure timeseries data
projects.summary: Develop and validate new analysis methods for wearable spectral light exposure timeseries data from the Spectrace sensor, focusing on unsupervised clustering, classification of spectral types, and decomposition of spectra into source spectra. The expected outcome is a working implementation (ideally in R) and a written report.

projects.title: Accelerating geophysical flow simulation using machine learning
projects.summary: Develop machine learning surrogate models, purely data-driven or physics-informed, that approximate high-fidelity physics-based geophysical flow simulations (e.g. MPM or DEM on 3D terrains) such as landslides, rockfalls and snow avalanches at a fraction of the computational cost. The work covers compiling and preprocessing a simulation dataset, training the model, and evaluating it on unseen terrains.

projects.title: AI-Enhanced Characterization of Internal Material Properties from Surface Observations
projects.summary: Develop a generalized AI-based inverse modeling framework that uses deep learning to infer internal material property distributions from surface responses such as displacement fields, using high-fidelity simulations, robust feature extraction and regularization to handle the ill-posedness of the inverse problem.

projects.title: Digital twin simulation of rockfall hazards
projects.summary: Develop a digital twin framework for simulating and assessing rockfall hazards in real-world terrains, using terrain reconstruction from drone or LiDAR data and the lab's in-house DEM code. The project also explores uncertainty quantification and machine learning surrogate models for risk mapping.

projects.title: Experimental Investigation of Architected Granular Materials
projects.summary: Study architected granular materials, whose particle shapes, surface properties and packing are designed to control macroscopic mechanical behavior. The work involves 3D-printing custom particles, assembling controlled granular packings, running static and dynamic mechanical tests with digital image correlation, and linking microscale interactions to macroscale stiffness and energy absorption.

projects.title: Frictional instabilities in topologically interlocked structures
projects.summary: The project studies how stick-slip frictional instabilities and interfacial heterogeneity affect the failure mechanisms of topologically interlocked structures. The student will use the level-set discrete element modeling framework to investigate their dynamic behaviour under various conditions.

projects.title: Graph Neural Networks for Granular Mechanics
projects.summary: Use graph neural networks to study how force-chain networks in granular materials evolve under shear as they approach unjamming and failure. Models are to be trained on discrete element simulations and grain-scale experimental measurements.

projects.title: Multiphysics modeling of fault gouge
projects.summary: The project uses combined discrete and continuum simulations to study fault gouge rheology, including the effects of material heterogeneity, grain-scale characteristics, particle fracture, and hydromechanical and thermomechanical coupling. The goal is to better understand earthquake mechanics.

projects.title: Phase-field modeling of fracture in architected structural materials
projects.summary: The project develops and applies phase-field fracture models to simulate crack initiation and propagation in architected structural materials such as truss lattices and bioinspired composites. It aims to understand how microstructural features influence fracture toughness, fracture modes and energy dissipation, and to explore machine-learning surrogate models for phase-field evolution.

projects.title: Physics-informed Deep Neural Operators for Solid Mechanics
projects.summary: The student explores physics-informed deep neural operators (PINOs) for solid mechanics problems, aiming to simulate material behaviour under various loading conditions in geotechnical or structural engineering. The generalization of the method is evaluated and its accuracy is compared with conventional numerical solutions.

projects.title: Segregation in Granular Flows
projects.summary: The project studies how particle shape influences segregation in granular flows, using numerical simulations of particles of varying shapes and sizes under shear and gravity. The goal is to analyse the inter-particle forces involved and to provide insights for continuum modelling of segregation.

projects.title: AI-Based Subsurface Characterisation
projects.summary: Develops AI-based workflows for automated stratigraphic characterisation from cone penetration test (CPT) and borehole data, with quantified uncertainty in layer boundaries to support 3D subsurface modelling for infrastructure projects.

projects.title: In Situ Stress at Mont Terri
projects.summary: Reconstructs and interprets in situ stress components from multi-borehole stress measurements of the IS-E experiment at the Mont Terri Rock Laboratory, and validates the EPFL-LMS methodology for full stress-state reconstruction. The work covers data quality checks, post-processing and uncertainty assessment.

projects.title: Lexicon of geological CO₂ storage (GCS)
projects.summary: Revise and document the fundamental principles of geological CO₂ storage and implement them on an EPFL-designed online website. The project also aims to update data on existing GCS projects and storage capacity in Europe and worldwide, and prepare open data sharing.

projects.title: Pore Pressure in Underground Storage
projects.summary: Develops a poromechanical framework to model pore-pressure evolution in deep underground storage such as H₂ and CO₂ storage, and derives the resulting effective stress paths. The student implements the model in MATLAB or Python and compares injection and withdrawal scenarios.

projects.title: Soil Water Retention
projects.summary: Experimentally investigates the water retention mechanisms of compacted soils, quantifying the contributions of adsorbed and capillary water to retention behaviour. The work includes a literature review, laboratory testing, and collaboration with the University of Genoa and ENTPE Lyon.

projects.title: Emergence of complexity in a frictional system: reproducing earthquake statistics
projects.summary: Study how adding disorder to a simple frictional slip system affects the transition between power-law and log-normal distributions of slip event sizes, as a way to understand the origin of earthquake statistics. The student uses the Akantu finite element software developed in the lab.

projects.title: Finite-Element Design of Thermal Buffering Units
projects.summary: Develop a finite-element model of heat transfer in a salt-hydrate latent heat storage unit and use simulations to compare geometries and operating conditions to maximise power density without losing storage capacity. An optional second part involves building a prototype with experimentalists and calibrating the model against measurements.

projects.title: How microcracks interactions influence macroscale fracture advance
projects.summary: Reproduce the microcrack nucleation, growth and coalescence ahead of a main crack in dynamic mode I fracture, using rate-dependent cohesive laws in the open-source cRacklet spectral boundary interface model. The aim is to understand the mechanics behind comet patterns observed on PMMA fracture surfaces.

projects.title: Neural networks meet finite elements
projects.summary: Combine the finite element method with machine-learning tools by analysing recent methods from the literature, such as the Deep Ritz Method, and adapting them to large-deformation problems in simple geometries.

projects.title: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for friction
projects.summary: Survey efficient ways to train physics-informed neural networks and apply them to solve stick-slip friction problems. An optional mathematical direction analyses the convergence and error estimates of PINNs.

projects.title: Soft lubrication of solid impacts
projects.summary: Investigate how soft solids impacting rigid surfaces behave, with a focus on the effect of surface topography on contact region formation and air trapping under quasi-static conditions. The student implements a 2D finite-difference simulation in Python.

projects.title: Study the consequences of the break-up of the geostationary satellite Luch/Olymp
projects.summary: Study how fragments from the 2026 break-up of the decommissioned geostationary satellite Luch/Olymp disperse in orbit and whether the debris cloud threatens operational and decommissioned satellites in GEO. The work includes processing astronomical images to obtain fragment data and performing long-term orbit propagation.

projects.title: Wave propagation in layered media (theoretical)
projects.summary: Theoretical project exploring how abstract algebra can help unravel the complexity of wave propagation through layered media, where repeated reflection, transmission and superposition create intricate wave patterns.

projects.title: Aerial Aquatic Multirotor Project
projects.summary: Student project on a multirotor robot able to operate in both air and water.

projects.title: Aerial Underwater Module Quagga Mussel
projects.summary: Student project on an aerial-underwater module, with a quagga mussel theme. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Biodegradable Communication Device
projects.summary: Student project on a biodegradable communication device for robotic or environmental use. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Biodegradable Motor
projects.summary: Student project on developing a biodegradable motor for robotic applications. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: EPFL Student Project Proposal AM
projects.summary: Student project proposal on an aerial multirotor (AM) topic. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: LSR Student Project AAM Impinging
projects.summary: Student project on impinging flow or impact studies related to the aerial aquatic multirotor (AAM) platform. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: LSR Student Project AAM MPC
projects.summary: Student project on model predictive control for the aerial aquatic multirotor (AAM) platform. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Mushroom drones for environmental exploration
projects.summary: Develop mycelium-woodchip bio-hybrid composites and optimise their mechanical properties and biodegradability. The work aims to build a transient drone platform for environmental monitoring, with electrode-integrated composites for sensing external stimuli.
skills: laboratory work with fungi and composites

projects.title: Plant Robot
projects.summary: Student project on a robot that integrates living plants. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: SailMAV Student Proposal
projects.summary: Student project proposal on a sailing micro air vehicle (SailMAV) concept. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: SPINE V2
projects.summary: Student project titled SPINE V2 (version 2), described in a downloadable proposal document.

projects.title: Damages related to extreme precipitation in urban environment
projects.summary: Semester project on damages caused by extreme precipitation in urban environments.

projects.title: Evaluation of the global LMDZ model for the simulation of clouds and precipitation microphysics in Antarctica
projects.summary: Semester project evaluating the global LMDZ model's simulation of clouds and precipitation microphysics in Antarctica.

projects.title: Hydrometeor classification with lidars and ceilometers
projects.summary: Master project on classifying hydrometeors from lidar and ceilometer observations, in collaboration with MeteoSwiss in Payerne.

projects.title: Stratus detection over the Swiss plateau
projects.summary: Master project on detecting stratus clouds over the Swiss plateau, in collaboration with MeteoSwiss in Payerne.

projects.title: Hands4Health – Reaction kinetics between chlorine and amides in reused handwashing water
projects.summary: Study the reaction kinetics between chlorine and amides at different pH values and temperatures to support chlorine dosing in reused handwashing water for stand-alone handwashing systems used in low- and middle-income countries.
supervisors: the postdoc working on this topic

projects.title: A Macroscopic Approach to Managing Prioritized Low-Altitude Aircraft Transport Systems
projects.summary: The project models low-altitude aircraft transport systems within the macroscopic fundamental diagram framework and designs boundary control and departure management strategies that prioritise certain aircraft and separate airspace.

projects.title: Adaptive Drone Sensing for Max-Pressure Traffic Signal Control
projects.summary: The project develops strategies for a limited drone fleet to dynamically choose which intersections to observe for Max-Pressure signal control, comparing them with fixed sensing configurations.

projects.title: Can Vehicle Composition Predict Urban Congestion? Analysis of traffic dynamics using large-scale vehicle trajectories collected from a swarm of drones
projects.summary: The project studies how the mix of vehicle types (cars, motorcycles, buses, trucks) affects the formation and recovery of urban congestion, using drone-extracted vehicle trajectories.

projects.title: Coordinated UAV Planning for Urban Delivery and Surveillance
projects.summary: The project designs a decision-making algorithm for UAVs that balances parcel delivery with road surveillance on a graph-based road network where road importance evolves with visits.

projects.title: Coordination and Efficiency in Persistent Multi-UAV Monitoring
projects.summary: The project studies how multiple UAVs in a grid environment should coordinate to keep information fresh across an area, using control, heuristic or reinforcement learning approaches compared in simulation.

projects.title: Deep Recurrent Q-Learning for Multi-Agent Patrolling
projects.summary: The project investigates deep recurrent Q-learning to train a fleet of patrolling agents that monitor congestion in a simplified 2D grid city environment.

projects.title: Estimating Macroscopic Traffic Conditions from Sparse Drone Observations
projects.summary: The project investigates whether sparse drone observations can estimate regional traffic states, such as vehicle counts and flows for perimeter control, using simple estimation and machine learning methods.

projects.title: Estimating the impact of pick-up and drop-off behaviors of ride-hailing vehicles on bus services
projects.summary: The project models the interaction between ride-hailing pick-up and drop-off at curbsides and bus services, using microscopic traffic simulation or an analytical approach.

projects.title: Low-Altitude Air City Transport (LAAT) systems
projects.summary: The project evaluates the artificial potential field collision avoidance used in a multi-drone simulator and develops and compares provably safe collision avoidance methods, to improve the accuracy of the LAAT macroscopic fundamental diagram.

projects.title: Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning with History-dependent Rewards for Cooperative Multi-UAV Traffic Monitoring
projects.summary: A drone fleet must coordinate its trajectories over a road network to prioritise important roads, under a history-dependent reward. The project investigates decentralised recurrent policies that use each drone's local observation history.

projects.title: Multispecies Traffic as Directed Percolation
projects.summary: The project uses simulation to study multispecies traffic, where two-wheelers percolate through car traffic, as a directed percolation phase transition and its critical exponents.

projects.title: On-demand Service Integration and Coordination with Bus Schedule Operation
projects.summary: The project develops an optimisation framework that improves on-demand vehicle-to-passenger assignment using historical bus data, so that on-demand micro-transit supports fixed-schedule bus operations.

projects.title: On Dual Control For Traffic Monitoring With a Fleet of Drones
projects.summary: The project designs and tests a multi-agent probabilistic optimal search framework based on dual control for exploration and exploitation, to localise congestion epicentres with a drone fleet using Bayesian inference.

projects.title: On Gaussian Process Dual Control for Multi-Agent Patrolling
projects.summary: The project explores modelling the temporal evolution of congestion with a Gaussian process and formulating a dual control problem to drive adaptive patrolling by a drone fleet.

projects.title: Operation of ride-sourcing as a first-mile feeder for public transit
projects.summary: The project models ride-pooling as a first-mile service complementing public transit in a simplified network with spatial restrictions on ride-sourcing access, and evaluates performance across operational scenarios.

projects.title: Optimizing drone delivery using bus networks
projects.summary: The project develops an optimisation framework in which drones ride buses with set stops and schedules to reduce total flying distance, and compares service levels with a no-bus scenario.

projects.title: Optimizing Fleet Operation using Potential Field-Based Algorithm
projects.summary: The project develops a potential-field algorithm that rebalances empty vehicles in autonomous mobility-on-demand systems, using attractive potentials towards demand and repulsive potentials to avoid clustering.

projects.title: Parking Availability Monitoring Using Drone Video Analytics
projects.summary: The project builds a parking occupancy estimation pipeline from drone-captured aerial videos, with a dashboard for real-time and predictive parking indicators and a demand case study.

projects.title: Pretraining Traffic Forecasting Models
projects.summary: The project explores masked-autoencoder-style pretraining of traffic prediction models to improve generalisation across cities, then fine-tunes the pretrained model on a new urban traffic dataset.

projects.title: Probabilistic Traffic Data Learning with Diffusion Models
projects.summary: The project applies denoising diffusion models to traffic forecasting to produce probabilistic predictions, starting from related work and transferring it to METR-LA and PEMS-Bay, with possible extension to missing-data imputation.

projects.title: Road and occlusion segmentation from drone video
